# Jubilees Chapter 37 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 37:4 — "as one sees the face of God"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I have seen thy face as one sees the face of God" | Literal; recalls Genesis 33:10 |
| LOGOS | "I have seen your face as one sees the face of God" | Same in modern English |
| PNEUMA | "When I last saw your face, it was like seeing the face of God" | Dynamic but changes the tense |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. Jacob quotes his own words from the reunion (Genesis 33:10 / Jubilees parallel). The present tense "I have seen" is the correct rendering; PNEUMA's past-tense paraphrase weakens the allusion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 37:5 — "the days of thy deception"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the days of thy deception and the wrong thou didst to me" | Literal double indictment |
| LOGOS | "the days when you deceived me and the wrong you did to me" | Unpacks "deception" into an act |
| PNEUMA | "the deceit, the theft of everything that was mine" | Amplifies — "theft" not in Ge'ez |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The Ge'ez uses two distinct terms (deception / wrong done). PNEUMA's "theft" introduces an element not present in the source text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 37:12 — second peace oath

All three translators agreed on the wording. No significant disagreement.

**Status:** No disagreement.

---
